meta.name: Sweetpea
meta.description: Rhiannon Lewis doesn't make much of an impression - people walk past her in the street without a second glance. That is until she is pushed over the edge and loses control. Rhiannon's life transforms, but can she keep her killer secret?

videos.title: Sorry for Your Loss
videos.overview: When her father dies and her bully returns, Rhiannon reaches her breaking point.

videos.title: This Sort of Thing Needs Some Feminine Energy
videos.overview: Rhiannon goes on a mission to find who her victim was.

videos.title: Black Spots in the Garage
videos.overview: High on power, Rhiannon goes after her next target: Julia Blenkingsopp.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Julia
videos.overview: Rhiannon sets out to prove she's not the loser she once was.

videos.title: Someone's Been a Naughty Girl
videos.overview: With suspicion swirling around Rhiannon, she and Julia make a truce.

videos.title: Life 2.0
videos.overview: Rhiannon might just get away with it - but what does she stand to lose in the process?

videos.title: Why Did You Have to Ruin Everything?
videos.overview: Rhiannon's plan to get over AJ and assert herself as a vigilante killer is thwarted in an unexpected way.

videos.title: I've Been Doing This a Lot Longer Than You
videos.overview: Rhiannon is determined to get ahead of a growing threat before it catches up with her. Convinced she knows where to look, she takes risky measures to find answers. Meanwhile, AJ's mum is asking increasingly difficult questions about his whereabouts and begins to suspect something is wrong
